ideal: A brief alert that Apple filed an amended current-events report (8-K/A) under item 5.02, which covers officer or director changes, with the link. It should note the report doesn't say what changed and should not invent details.

verdicts.note: Explains the amendment and item 5.02 in plain words, honestly says the details aren't known, and links the filing; slightly wordy.
verdicts.answer: Apple: filed an 8-K/A, a correction or update to an earlier current-events report. It's under Item 5.02, which covers directors or top officers leaving or joining, and can include their pay. This report doesn't say what changed: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000114036126035325/ef20081427_8ka.htm

verdicts.note: Clear and plain with the link, but it asserts there was a change and calls the filing 'the whole story', which goes beyond the evidence.
verdicts.answer: Apple — new filing: an amended current-events report (8-K/A) covering item 5.02, a change to its officers or directors. No unusual price move flagged that day, so the filing is the whole story. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000114036126035325/ef20081427_8ka.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate and linked, but it never explains what an 8-K/A or item 5.02 means or why it matters.
